tagline: An Asian side district with ferry connections to the Princes' Islands, a lively waterfront, and a well-established local café and dining scene.

items.name: Bostancı İskelesi Cafés
items.description: Cafés and tea houses around the busy Bostancı ferry terminal. Watch the Princes' Islands ferries depart while having coffee.

items.name: Bostancı Sahil Restoranları
items.description: A strip of fish and seafood restaurants along the Bostancı waterfront with Marmara and island views. Consistent quality.

items.name: Bostancı Çarşı Lokantalari
items.description: The market area has a good range of lokanta restaurants with rotating daily menus. Very local and very good value.

items.name: Ferry to Princes' Islands
items.description: Bostancı has frequent ferry service to the Princes' Islands (Büyükada, Heybeliada) — closer than Kabataş and often less crowded.
items.tip: The Bostancı ferries to the islands are often faster and less crowded than the Kabataş route. A good alternative for Asian side residents.

items.name: Bostancı Sahili Promenadı
items.description: A pleasant waterfront promenade connecting to Caddebostan. Good for evening walks with island views.

tips: Bostancı is on the M4 metro line — well connected to Kadıköy and the rest of the Asian side.
The Princes' Islands ferries from Bostancı are a great alternative to the more crowded European side ferries.
More developed and livelier than neighbouring Maltepe and Kartal.
Good for families living on the Asian side who want easy island access.
